limitations: Contact speed is a geom-center proxy, including foot rolling; not a zero-slip claim.
Only chest and split-foot collision geometry exists. Limb self-contact is not physically enforced.
SMPL-H constraints infer spine distribution; individual spine joints are not directly measured.
Kinematic replay is distinct from unassisted dynamic policy rollout.
